singular-possessive-map.title: Match each full singular form with its contracted form
singular-possessive-map.bodyMarkdown:
In Kreyòl, possession can often be expressed with a full form or a shorter everyday form. Learn the singular pairs below:

| Meaning | Full form | Contracted form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mine | pa mwen an | pa m nan |
| yours | pa ou a | pa w la |
| his / hers / its | pa li a | pa l la |
| ours | pa nou an | pa n nan |
| yours | pa nou an | pa n nan |
| theirs | pa yo a | no contracted form |

The pair **pa nou an / pa n nan** can mean both **ours** and plural **yours**. **Pa yo a** has no contracted partner in this set.

singular-contracted-pairs.title: Practice each full and short form as a pair
singular-contracted-pairs.bodyMarkdown:
Practice the full and short forms together:

- **pa mwen an** → **pa m nan**
- **pa ou a** → **pa w la**
- **pa li a** → **pa l la**
- **pa nou an** → **pa n nan**

Learn these pairs as complete expressions. Focus on using them naturally rather than trying to build a broader contraction rule.

plural-possessive-map.title: Use yo in the plural possessive forms
plural-possessive-map.bodyMarkdown:
Now compare the plural possessive forms:

| Meaning | Full form | Contracted form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mine | pa mwen yo | pa m yo |
| yours | pa ou yo | pa w yo |
| his / hers / its | pa li yo | pa l yo |
| ours | pa nou yo | pa n yo |
| yours | pa nou yo | pa n yo |
| theirs | pa yo | no contracted form |

The pair **pa nou yo / pa n yo** can mean both **ours** and plural **yours**. **Pa yo** has no contracted partner in this set.
